tests.name: unflatten_long_key_linear
tests.intent: Probes unflatten behavior on a long key with many tokens to verify correctness and scalability.

tests.name: unflatten_ordered_json_prefix_conflict
tests.intent: Tests overlapping keys in ordered_json to ensure that conflicting values correctly trigger type_error.

tests.name: unflatten_short_limit_boundary
tests.intent: Probes unflatten prefix tree hand-over boundary around 64 bytes with varied token lengths.

tests.name: unflatten_reseeded_hash_collision
tests.intent: Probes hash collision safety with multiple keys having similar hash prefixes.

tests.name: unflatten_null_prefix_allowed
tests.intent: Checks that a null value shadowing an existing container during unflatten is tolerated.

tests.name: unflatten_array_and_object_mixed
tests.intent: Probes mixed array and object unflattening structures sharing common roots.

tests.name: unflatten_deep_escaped_tokens
tests.intent: Tests unflattening keys containing escaped characters like tilde and slash within deep structures.

tests.name: unflatten_empty_key
tests.intent: Exercises unflattening an empty key path representing the root value.

tests.name: unflatten_invalid_array_index
tests.intent: Probes error handling when an array index token is malformed during unflatten.

tests.name: unflatten_leading_zero_array
tests.intent: Validates proper array creation when reference token '0' is encountered.

tests.name: unflatten_repeated_common_prefixes
tests.intent: Probes optimization paths where consecutive keys share long common prefixes.

tests.name: unflatten_unsupported_type_conflict
tests.intent: Tests overlapping primitive and object paths throwing appropriate exception types.

tests.name: unflatten_ordered_json_shuffled
tests.intent: Verifies round-trip consistency of ordered_json flatten and unflatten operations.

tests.name: unflatten_numeric_object_keys
tests.intent: Probes unflattening keys that look like numbers but are treated as object property names rather than array indices.

tests.name: unflatten_large_index_array
tests.intent: Tests sparse or large array index allocations during unflattening.

tests.name: unflatten_consecutive_slashes
tests.intent: Probes handling of empty tokens caused by consecutive slashes in JSON pointer keys.

tests.name: unflatten_trailing_slash
tests.intent: Probes behavior when a JSON pointer key ends with a slash character.

tests.name: unflatten_boolean_and_float_leaves
tests.intent: Validates unflattening with diverse leaf node types such as booleans and floating-point numbers.

tests.name: unflatten_deep_nesting_limit
tests.intent: Probes performance and correctness with deep nesting levels approaching stack constraints.

tests.name: unflatten_multiple_distinct_trees
tests.intent: Exercises unflattening an object containing multiple completely disjoint top-level branches.

tests.name: unflatten_invalid_array_index_fixed
tests.intent: Probes error handling when an array index token is malformed during unflatten.

tests.name: unflatten_unsupported_type_conflict_fixed
tests.intent: Tests overlapping primitive and object paths throwing appropriate exception types.

tests.name: unflatten_large_index_array_fixed
tests.intent: Tests sparse or large array index allocations during unflattening.
